scope: Independent raw reconstruction of all predeclared thirty A/A, twelve competitive primary and forty auxiliary contrasts for the sole F64 window. Numeric correctness and formal-target acceptance are separate results.

independent_raw.raw_chain_format: SHA256(initial ASCII F64-INDEPENDENT-NATIVE-RECEIPT-SCHEDULE-ORDER-v1 plus NUL; in frozen native schedule order, uint64be length then bytes for job ID ASCII, raw native JSON, raw receipt JSON).
independent_raw.numerical_method: 90-digit Decimal odd-df63 Student tail via t=sqrt(df)*tan(theta), cos^(df-1) tail-integral recurrence, Machin pi, atan series and 230-step bisection; exact binary64 original family probabilities. No original project module imported.

auxiliary.interpretation: No original cost-transfer veto is triggered. Unknown intervals are preserved and are not proof of no regression.

reload.original_family: Part of the predeclared forty two-sided auxiliary contrasts; no separate or post-hoc test.
reload.scope: The frozen XOffset detached owning-copy reload and full-validation contract remain unchanged. Native phase boundaries and complete truth/body checks are the original maintained ones. Competitor modes remain exactly frozen; this review does not reinterpret the comparison as uniform extra validation or add a reload ratio gate.

policy.unit: 64 balanced macrocycle means, not native children, role pairs or single blocks.
policy.derived: Integer read_sum and eight-phase total are derived/validated before log ratios.
policy.AA_direction: Within-role chronological first divided by chronological second.
policy.contrast_direction: new_xoffset divided by same-window other role; primary includes four fixed competitors only.
policy.zero_policy: Keep invalid positions and undefined inference; no deletion or epsilon. No measured zero occurred.
policy.confidence: Three separate nominal model-conditional simultaneous 95% families. No combined overall 95%, distribution-free or coverage conditional on AA passing claim.

numeric_canonical_interpretation.canonical_preserved: Every canonical number in the result tables is taken unchanged from the original sealed analysis after independent reconstruction of all raw native/receipt data. The complete original offline audit analysis equals that sealed analysis, including rejection and uncertainty fields.
numeric_canonical_interpretation.canonical_critical_reconstruction: Using the exact original three frozen critical values, all 82 independently reconstructed block vectors, macrocycle vectors, moments, point estimates and interval fields match canonical exactly: 0 ULP. No project mathematical or executor module was imported.
numeric_canonical_interpretation.independent_high_precision_quantile: A separate 90-digit Decimal odd-df Student-tail integral is a numeric crosscheck, not a replacement statistic or new acceptance rule. Its critical differences from original canonical are 41/32/50 ULP for AA/primary/auxiliary (absolute maxima 2.220446049250313e-14).
numeric_canonical_interpretation.independent_endpoint_differences: With those independent high-precision quantiles, AA ratio endpoints differ at most 1 ULP / 2.220446049250313e-16; primary ratio upper at most 1 ULP / 5.551115123125783e-17; auxiliary ratio endpoints at most 6 ULP / 1.7053025658242404e-13. The auxiliary maximum log-bound ULP count is 232; field-specific absolute/ULP ranges are fully recorded. All 82 verdicts remain identical.
numeric_canonical_interpretation.rules_unchanged: No numerical difference was used to widen a limit, change roundoff/zero handling, omit an observation or add samples.

attribution.reason: Primary acceptance is candidate divided by each fixed competitor. Old-control diagnostics describe the combined candidate only and do not identify independent R1 versus M2 contributions.

final_decision: The sole F64 measurement is qualified and its statistical reconstruction is accepted. Formal competitive targets are NOT achieved: only 3/12 pass; nine fail, including all four independent-output <=0.20 targets. Candidate promotion and completion of the formal performance objective are not accepted by this result. Preserve the full window and all failures; no retry, extended sample, altered threshold or optional-interface substitution is authorized.
external_identity_scope: The original mathematical record does not itself assert external binary identity verification. Actual frozen binary/source/runtime identity and semantic/body closure are provided by the accepted exact freeze, execution admission and complete maintained offline audit. This review preserves that scope and does not flip the original math flag.
